info.name: Holiday Finder API
info.description:
All the routes of the Holiday Finder backend: Auth, Vacations, Likes, Images, Admin and AI.

Run the whole collection with the Collection Runner using a delay of at least 250 ms - the server allows only 5 requests per second.

The folders use the tokens saved by the Auth folder - run the Auth folder (or at least the two login requests) first.
